stem:
Acebutolol is a drug that can be used to lower blood pressure.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give the **full name** of the circled functional groups labelled **P**, **Q** and **R** in acebutolol.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
On the diagram of acebutolol below, draw a **circle** around any chiral carbon atoms.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: On warming with dilute hydrochloric acid, acebutolol splits to form two molecules.
parts.text: Draw a line through the bond broken by heating with dilute hydrochloric acid.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the structure of the **smaller** molecule produced by this reaction.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Suggest what would be observed when acebutolol reacts with the following reagents. If no reaction would take place, write 'none' in the table below.

| reagent | observation |
| :--- | :--- |
| alkaline iodine solution |  |
| universal indicator solution |  |
| 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine |  |
| Tollens' reagent |  |

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.stem: Butanoic acid can be reduced to form compound **N**. Compound **N** reacts with sodium.
parts.text: Suggest a suitable reducing agent for this reaction.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the **skeletal** formula of the isomer of **N** that exists as a pair of optical isomers.

parts.label: (e)(iii)
parts.text:
Another isomer of **N** does **not** react with acidified dichromate(VI) solution but does react with sodium.

Draw the structure of this isomer.
